patch_description: This version interpolates the core toward Gen 53's proven high-accuracy operating point while keeping the guarded terminal suppressor stack intact. Key changes: (1) raise the acceleration-noise cap from 0.5·sigma_r to 0.85·sigma_r (allowing more dynamics through, improving correlation, noise reduction and lag), (2) loosen the local penalty-relaxation gate (threshold 1.5→1.2·noise_d2, floor 0.15→0.10) so genuine curvature regions get less smoothing, (3) add a centered Hampel despiker (window 7, 3·local-MAD, skipped if >5% of samples flagged) before the solver to mirror Gen 53's preprocessing, and (4) keep the residual-scale-aware bilateral one-pole dampers clamped to [0.60, 0.95] with the same alpha schedule so reversals stay near ~14 and smoothness stays high. The composite gain in correlation/noise-reduction should outweigh the small smoothness cost, netting a higher combined score. All I/O contracts (function names, slicing, output length) are unchanged.
